title: fix(update): carry the run id into managed-helper candidate inspection
body:
Closes #158881

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: a real systemd `update.run` handoff rejects its authorized helper with `managed-service-preflight / inside-gateway-process-tree` before package mutation.

## User Impact

Managed helpers can complete candidate inspection, package replacement, and native Gateway restart while retaining the existing live-lease authority checks. Genuine Gateway children and helpers with missing or mismatched authority remain refused. Thanks @obviyus for the real-systemd report.

An already-installed buggy updater still owns the first hop before candidate code runs. External-shell recovery to the candidate was verified with published `2026.9.6`; subsequent managed updates use the repaired preflight.

## Why This Change Was Made

A systemd transient scope can retain Gateway ancestry while occupying a sibling cgroup. Candidate inspection supplies no explicit `updateRun`, so the ancestry exception received no run ID and returned before checking the helper's lease. The preflight now supplies the inherited run ID when explicit context is absent. Metadata, installation root, lease owner, executor PID, and live start-identity checks remain authoritative; no run ID means refusal.

The reporter's `b5251e96b76` already contains the guard rewrite in `6209f31ce9bb` (#158314). This repairs the existing preflight owner rather than changing systemd membership policy. Production net LOC: 0 (one functional line plus the contract comment); tests: +6; docs: 0.

## Evidence

- **Real systemd before/after:** the main-snapshot control reproduced the reported refusal before mutation and left the same Gateway PID healthy. On the repaired source, real `systemd-run --user --scope` retained ancestry `636 → 628 → 381 → user manager` while moving the helper/updater into a sibling scope. The live lease matched the handoff owner and executor start identity. Candidate admission returned `admit`, with all four checks `ok`. Package version changed from `2026.9.6` to the repository's local-only `2026.9.99-first-hop.0` fixture; the helper exited 0; systemd restarted PID 381 as PID 3700. The durable run reported `succeeded`, with version match, readiness, and health verified.
- **Live proof identity:** Testbox `tbx_01m3f687wx1mdczt2r9x418h4w` ([run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36253017016)); update run `ba414d86-9cf7-4c62-8a62-a34fd04f3e43`; handoff lease owner `27312f65-962e-4a20-b3bb-074f0b8e3a5e`; executor PID/start identity `636 / 110597`. Linux x64, Debian systemd 252 as PID 1, privileged Docker with host cgroup namespace, lingering normal user, isolated profile/state, free loopback port, and loopback registry. The ad hoc rig uses `scripts/package-openclaw-for-docker.mjs`, `scripts/e2e/lib/update-first-hop-package-fixtures.mjs`, and `scripts/e2e/lib/plugins/npm-registry-server.mjs`; no systemctl shim.
- **Published driver × candidate:** published `2026.9.6` ran `openclaw update --tag file:<candidate.tgz> --yes --json --no-restart` from an isolated external shell. Result `ok`, run `e531c9ea-940f-4031-ad04-3e50d888d28a`; the installed build metadata exactly matched the candidate artifact.
- **Regression and sibling suites:** six authorized-helper inspection cases failed on unchanged production code. After the fix, all 88 focused cases passed three times on rebased main. `pnpm test src/cli/update-cli/update-command-service-maintenance-handoff.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: 20.96 / 18.35 / 19.78 s wall (about 4–5 s test time). All 42 direct/barrel-dependent files passed: 1,116 tests, 506.62 s wall, with landed fixture isolation from #158873 and no overlay. [Testbox run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36252968977). Per-file PR CI timing is not available at authoring handoff.
- **Changed-file checks:** the full `node scripts/check-changed.mjs` invocation stops at a pre-existing max-lines suppression in untouched `extensions/openrouter/index.test.ts:1272` (absent from the baseline). This finding is recorded without changing the file, baseline, or guard. Every remaining step from the repository's check plan passed, including the separate environment budget, core production types, all 25 consuming test type graphs, targeted lint, formatting, docs checks, dead-export scans, and architecture guards. [Remaining-check Testbox run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36253373701). Package build and tarball integrity checks passed. Fresh P1 autoreview: scoped-clean.

slow-test follow-up: update-command-original-service.test.ts spawns snapshot/schema-reader processes per recovery check; owner: CLI tooling
